title: Long-Term Visit Pass and LTVP Plus Holders in Workforce
what_it_is: Long-Term Visit Pass and LTVP Plus Holders in Workforce

sections.label: LTVP holders working in Singapore
sections.summary: Foreign spouses or unmarried children under 21 of citizens or PRs with LTVP or LTVP+ can work with LOC or PLOC; 17,890 LTVP and LTVP+ holders are in the workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Foreign spouses or unmarried children under 21 years old of Singapore Citizens (SC) or Permanent Residents (PR) who have LTVP or LTVP+ can work in Singapore if they are also issued with Letters of Consent (LOC) or Pre-approved Letters of Consent (PLOC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Other LTVP holders, such as parents of citizens and Permanent Residents can work in Singapore if they are also issued with a regular work pass.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As at December 2020, there are 17,890 LTVP and LTVP+ holders who are part of our workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Of this, 190 or about 1% are self-employed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Collectively, the employed LTVP and LTVP+ constitute about 0.5% of our workforce.

sections.label: Self-employment for LTVP holders
sections.summary: Self-employment is allowed for LTVP and LTVP+ holders, who need a valid LOC or PLOC and must be hired by the same firm listed in ACRA records.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
sentences.text: So, I just wanted to confirm that there is no impediment or there is no difficulty or confusing procedure for them to go through to obtain the ability to be self-employed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: We do allow self-employment amongst our LTVP and LTVP+ holders.

sentences.speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
sentences.text: However, to be classified as self-employed, they would need a valid LOC/PLOC and be hired by the same firm for which they are listed as director, partner, limited partner or sole proprietor in the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority's records.
